title: Mottainai
tagline: Your wallet account holds your blockchain journey and memories, like POAPs and SBTs.   Tidy up unwanted tokens and keep using it long-term!
description:
By using this service, you can easily organize unwanted tokens in your wallet and receive eco-friendly NFTs with utility. Furthermore, once the project is completed, disposed tokens will be automatically categorized into Major Token, Stable Token, Alt Coin, and Scam Token, with operations carried out for each category. Profits generated from these operations will be returned to users as ETH, allowing you to withdraw ETH at your preferred timing.
Organizing your wallet allows for long-term continued use of the wallet. Additionally, in countries with strict taxation on crypto assets, organizing your wallet before filing your tax return enables accurate balance calculations and simplifies the tax filing process.
This feature is highly useful in cases where the gas fees for individually swapping tokens worth less than one dollar are higher than the tokens received after the swap. Therefore, it caters to a wide range of users, from those dabbling with small amounts of crypto to those managing large sums.
This service allows you to easily organize your wallet, acquire eco-friendly NFTs, and provides a system that automatically categorizes tokens, optimizes operations, and returns profits as ETH. With long-term wallet use, simplified tax filing, and efficient handling of tokens worth less than a dollar, this service offers great convenience to users.
how_its_made:
This time, we participated as a team for the first time. We divided our tasks into three groups: those responsible for advancing the project development, front-end developers, and back-end developers. The team responsible for advancing the development consistently checked progress and determined compromises as needed to reach the final goal. This project uses the IPFS behind the scenes.
We used Next JS to design the frontend.
